from manim import *

class EulerFormulaVisualization(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # --- Setup Title ---
        title = MathTex(r"Euler's Formula", font_size=40)
        self.play(Write(title))
        self.wait(0.5)

        # --- Define the Unit Circle and Axes ---
        # Create a coordinate system for context
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[-3, 3, 1],
            y_range=[-3, 3, 1],
            axis_config={"include_numbers": True},
            tips=False,
        ).t
